source_claim: The official ARIA The CREPUSCOLO goods page identifies an 'ARIA original' gondola figure set and lists Maa-shacho (まぁ社長) among the four Orange Planet characters included in the set. This explicitly associates Maa-shacho with the ARIA work.
notes: The goods page is part of the official ARIA portal and marks the product as ARIA original; only the exact campaign character named in the product set is proposed.
